decisions.reason: The comfort insole remains close to the firm's footwear and fit expertise and benefits from established channels, but as a non-flagship insole it still carries some portfolio-rationalisation risk if it proves less differentiated than the firm's stronger foot-support offerings.

The ergonomic safety shoe series builds directly on the firm's core protective-footwear knowledge and production capabilities, so management is likely to keep refining and exploiting what it has learned rather than withdraw it.

The moulded insole is a flagship, highly related to the firm's existing know-how in footwear fit and comfort, and therefore is the kind of product the firm is most able and willing to improve commercially rather than abandon.
